game.title: Doom Eternal
game.blurb: Fast first-person shooter from id Software, released 2020-03-19. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 782330)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Doom_Eternal
Fandom (doom.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://doom.fandom.com/wiki/Doom_Eternal
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page "Doom Eternal" (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); only its "Achievements and trophies" and "Table of Contents" subpages are written. The contents page links mission pages (for example "Hell on Earth", "Exultia", "Cultist Base" and "Urdak"), but none is written, so nothing was used. doom.fandom.com answers the API under "Doom Eternal" with about 190 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 16 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden. Steam API names run NEW_ACHIEVEMENT_1_x and NEW_ACHIEVEMENT_2_x; the 2_x block holds the "(Ancient Gods 1)", "(Ancient Gods 2)" and Horde Mode achievements. Hidden 2_1 to 2_3 ("Torrential Pain", "To Take a Life Sphere", "Regime Change") sit just before the Ancient Gods 1 ones, and 2_8 to 2_10 and 2_12 ("Crystal Spelunker", "Cross the Threshold", "Siege the Day", "Rest Your Weary Fists") sit among the Ancient Gods 2 ones, so they were put in those expansion chapters; "Reinvent the Weapon Wheel" (no mode named) sits between the two Horde Mode achievements, so it was put there. All three placements are guesses from position and need checking. The other 9 hidden ones sit in the campaign chapter. Expansion names come from RAWG and the Steam app list ("The Ancient Gods - Part One" and "Part Two").
